case.summary: Case HHG-006 was initiated following a dispute from customer C07297 reporting an unauthorized $482.12 online transaction (3476682) on card C07297-K1. Investigation identified a four-transaction episode on 2016-11-21 between 20:00:00 and 20:30:00 totaling $1,906.07 across regions 264 and 476. The transactions reflect an undocumented structuring pattern of purchases just below the $500 threshold conducted via a new device profile. Given a calibrated fraud probability of 0.92 and five matching confirmed-fraud prior cases, the activity was confirmed as fraud, leading to card blocking, escalation, and SAR filing.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report relates to customer C07297 and card C07297-K1 regarding unauthorized card-not-present transactions. Between 20:00:00 and 20:30:00 on 2016-11-21, four online transactions for product C were executed across regions 264 and 476 totaling $1,906.07. Specifically, these included transaction 3476602 ($478.95 in region 264), transaction 3476633 ($456.96 in region 476), transaction 3476665 ($488.04 in region 476), and transaction 3476682 ($482.12 in region 264). Customer C07297 triggered the investigation by reporting transaction 3476682 as unauthorized. The activity was conducted via a device profile (D000061: Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080) marked as new for this account. The transactions exhibit structuring behavior, where four purchases were placed within 30 minutes just below the $500 authorization limit. The charges significantly deviate from the card's baseline average of $115.15 across 101 prior transactions (z=2.5). The supervised model estimated a calibrated fraud probability of 0.92, supported by five out of five similar prior cases confirmed as fraud. Filing is executed under policy R9 as total exposure exceeds $1,000 with an undocumented structuring pattern.
